nodes.name: .env.template
nodes.summary: Template for runtime environment variables covering data root path, HuggingFace model ID, S3 bucket, Weights & Biases settings, and optional torch.compile disable flag; intended to be copied to .env and sourced before running preprocessing, training, or inference scripts.

nodes.name: .pre-commit-config.yaml
nodes.summary: Pre-commit hook configuration enforcing trailing-whitespace removal, end-of-file fixing, YAML validity, merge-conflict detection, and Ruff-based linting and formatting on every commit.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Ruff (astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit v0.9.6) for both lint (--fix) and format passes, replacing older flake8/black combos.

nodes.name: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
nodes.summary: Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct (7 sections) defining community standards, maintainer responsibilities, scope of enforcement, and reporting procedures for unacceptable behavior.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Brief contribution guide directing contributors to read CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md before getting started; serves as the entry point for new contributors.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Primary project documentation covering installation, dataset generation, training, and inference for the KVP (KV Policy) framework — lightweight per-head RL agents that learn to rank KV cache entries by predicted future utility for adaptive LLM eviction; includes citation, acknowledgements, and license sections.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Python project manifest for the kvcompression package defining build system (setuptools + git-versioning), runtime dependencies (PyTorch, flash-attn, transformers, torchtune, wandb, s3fs, etc.), uv workspace source and dual PyTorch index configuration for CPU vs CUDA 12.8 platforms, and tool settings for pytest, mypy, and ruff.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses uv workspace with explicit PyTorch package indexes split by sys_platform to serve CPU wheels on non-Linux and CUDA 12.8 wheels on Linux; flash-attn requires special extra-build-dependencies workaround due to a known uv issue.
